title: Compact agent handoffs
summary: Pass structured findings and evidence identifiers rather than entire conversations.

sections.label: Handoff fields
items: Confirmed observations and exact source locations.
Actions executed, resulting artifacts, and verification results.
Unresolved questions, constraints, and next required decision.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: The receiving agent can retrieve underlying evidence and continue without inheriting irrelevant conversation or silently losing constraints.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
